name: Tinker Flak Guns delivers +15% critical damage, not +15 damage (#1960)
contract: #1960: Flak Guns (520686) reads 'Your Mechsuit: Combustion now has 10% increased critical strike chance and 15% increased critical damage'. Spell.dbc row 520686 encodes both halves as SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER on class mask (0,0,0x4000), the mask of Combustion (801388): effect 0 MiscValue 7 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE) BasePoints 9 DieSides 1 = +10, effect 1 MiscValue 15 (SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS) BasePoints 14 DieSides 1 = +15. SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE is consumed as percentage points, so the flat form of effect 0 is correct. SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS is applied to the absolute critical bonus, so the flat form of effect 1 adds 15 raw damage; the percentage form multiplies it by 1.15. Applied to a base of 1000, the fixed effect 1 yields 1150 and the unfixed one 1015.

steps.label: Combustion carries no critical strike chance modifier before Flak Guns
Combustion carries no critical damage modifier before Flak Guns
Flak Guns is active on the Tinker
Flak Guns still adds 10 percentage points of Combustion critical strike chance
Flak Guns raises Combustion's critical damage by 15 percent, not by 15 damage
